description.before: Die lernende Person kann saure und basische Lösungen auf der Teilchenebene durch das Vorhandensein von Oxonium- bzw. Hydroxid-Ionen charakterisieren.

descriptionEn.before: The learner can characterize acidic and basic solutions at particle level by the presence of oxonium or hydroxide ions.
descriptionEn.after: The learner can characterize acidic and basic aqueous solutions at particle level by the respective predominance of hydronium or hydroxide ions.

descriptionEn.before: The learner can use oxidation numbers, formulate simple redox half-equations, and write redox equations correctly.
descriptionEn.after: The learner can use oxidation numbers, formulate simple redox half-equations in aqueous solutions, and write redox equations correctly.

descriptionEn.before: The learner can explain how selected acid-base reactions involving proton transfers can be influenced.
descriptionEn.after: The learner can explain influences on selected acid-base reactions using the reversibility of proton transfers.
